name: open_banking_transactions
description: Live bank account transaction and balance data via Open Banking APIs. PSD2-compliant, covers 300+ UK and European banks. Optional inputs: account_id, limit (max 100), from_date. Returns categorised transactions with merchant data, amounts, and current balance. Suitable for affordability assessment, reconciliation, and financial due diligence.

account_id.description: Optional bank account ID to query. If omitted, returns data for the first available account.

limit.description: Number of transactions to return. Defaults to 10. Maximum 100.

from_date.description: Optional start date for transaction history in ISO format e.g. 2026-01-01
